# My Tech Journey

How I started coding, the challenges I faced, and what I'm learning right now.

## Where It All Began

Every developer has a unique story of how they wrote their first line of code. For me, it started with a simple curiosity about how the web works. I remember opening the browser's developer tools for the first time and being amazed that I could change the text on a live website (even if it was only on my screen!).

## The Learning Curve

Learning to code is rarely a straight line. There were days of endless debugging, reading documentation that felt like a foreign language, and the classic "it works on my machine" moments. But the feeling of finally solving a complex bug or seeing my first web page come to life made every frustrating moment worth it.

### Technologies I Fell in Love With

As I continued my journey, I discovered tools and frameworks that made building software incredibly enjoyable:

* **JavaScript & TypeScript:** The foundation of my modern web development.
* **React & Next.js:** Building dynamic, fast, and scalable user interfaces.
* **Tailwind CSS:** Styling components rapidly without leaving my HTML.

## What I'm Exploring Now

Technology moves fast, and there's always something new to learn. Currently, I am diving deeper into:

* Server-Side Rendering (SSR) and Server Components
* Improving web accessibility and performance
* Creating beautiful UI/UX designs

## The Road Ahead

This journey is a marathon, not a sprint. I'm excited to continue building projects, contributing to the community, and documenting my progress right here on this blog.

*Stay tuned for more updates, tutorials, and project showcases!*

# Welcome to PMreza's Portfolio

A modern developer portfolio and blog to showcase my work.

## Hello, World!

Welcome to my brand new portfolio website. I'm **Mohammad Amin Ahmadi** (also known as **PMreza**), a passionate developer who loves building beautiful, functional, and user-friendly web applications.

This website serves as my personal corner on the internet where I can:

* **Showcase my projects**: You'll find a collection of my latest work, side projects, and experiments.
* **Share my knowledge**: I plan to use this blog to write about the things I learn, coding tutorials, and my tech journey.
* **Connect**: Feel free to browse around, explore my components, or reach out to me!

## The Tech Stack

This site was built with modern web technologies, ensuring a fast, accessible, and smooth experience:

* **Next.js 15** - React framework for fast, server-rendered applications.
* **Tailwind CSS v4** - Utility-first CSS framework for rapid UI development.
* **shadcn/ui** - Beautifully designed, accessible, and customizable components.

I've also customized the design with a retro **pixel font (Silkscreen)** to give it a unique vibe that fits my style perfectly.

## What's Next?

I'll be updating this blog regularly with new content. Stay tuned for deeper dives into projects I've built, coding tips, and more. Thanks for stopping by!


Last updated on September 19, 2026
